gloss: to go too far; to be excessive; to overdo it

definitions.gloss: to go too far; to be excessive; to overdo it
definitions.explanation: Something exceeds an acceptable or reasonable limit. Used to criticize behavior, actions, or situations that have gone beyond what is appropriate.

examples.japanese: ⟦いたずら→いたずら：01794_itazura⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる。
examples.english: The pranks have gone too far.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|きず}つける→傷つける：01935_kizutsukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When jokes go too far, they can hurt people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心配|しんぱい}する→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わかる⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自立|じりつ}→自立：13970_jiritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{妨|さまた}げる→妨げる：12223_samatageru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I understand being worried, but when it goes too far, it can hinder a child's independence.

notes:
Combines ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree, extent) with ⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (to exceed). Expresses the idea that something has crossed the line of what is acceptable. Almost always used in a critical or cautionary tone.

USAGE:
Typically follows a noun with the particle ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる (even jokes can go too far). The ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ adds the nuance of "even X has limits." Can also be used as a modifier: {度|ど}が{過|す}ぎた⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ (an act that went too far).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる — jokes have gone too far
- ⟦いたずら→いたずら：01794_itazura⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる — pranks have gone too far
- ⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる — worrying has gone too far
- {度|ど}が{過|す}ぎた⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ — an excessive act

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やり→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ — to overdo it; more casual, broader application
- ⟦{行|い}き→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ — to go too far; similar meaning, often used for actions or policies
- ⟦{過度|かど}→過度：14377_kado⟧な — excessive; formal adjective form
